text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Powerhouses gather at Tokyo Racecourse in Fuchu!
Just who will seize the crown today?!
The Tenno Sho (Autumn) will begin shortly!
...I'll see it through to the end.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Before we head into the race, please let me say just this one thing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: With you as my Trainer, I—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Please bear witness.
To the moment the "now" we built together
shatters the promised history—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (...It feels like a long journey, yet at the same time, like it passed in the blink of an eye.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(And yet, within my heart,
lies a 'now' that rivals the countless stars.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Those dazzling, unfading days given to me by my beloved rivals—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (The memory of a glorious race—running side by side beyond our limits—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Without losing a single piece of any of it, I'll turn it all into my radiance "now".)
